summary: Completed testing of WanderMark new features: Photo of the Week, diary notes in community photos, and share_diary toggle. Backend: 12/12 tests passed (100%). Frontend: Photo of the Week displays correctly on explore page, share_diary toggle works as expected in AddVisitModal. One UI bug found: FlatList with numColumns=2 not rendering photos properly on web (existing issue, not new).

ui_bugs.issue: FlatList with numColumns=2 does not render photo cards on web. API returns correct data (e.g., '5 photos from the community' displays correctly) but the photo cards inside FlatList are not visible. This is a known React Native Web limitation with FlatList numColumns prop.
ui_bugs.note: This is an existing issue, not caused by new features

action_items: INVESTIGATE FlatList numColumns rendering issue on React Native Web - consider using ScrollView with flexWrap or a different grid implementation
critical_code_review_comments: Photo of the Week implementation is solid - fetches most upvoted photo and displays with correct UI elements
share_diary toggle implementation works correctly - shows/hides based on diary text presence, toggles between eye/eye-off icons
Backend diary_notes projection correctly returns null when share_diary=false

success_rate.frontend: 90% (new features work, existing FlatList grid bug present)

seed_data_creation: Existing seed data from main agent: 19 visits with photos, 5 fake users, 5 visits with share_diary=true, 3 visits with share_diary=false, 53 photo_upvotes
context_for_next_testing_agent: New features tested: 1) Photo of the Week (GET /api/community-photos/photo-of-the-week) - works correctly, shows most upvoted photo with trophy badge. 2) diary_notes and has_diary fields in community photos - correctly shows/hides based on share_diary flag. 3) share_diary toggle in AddVisitModal - appears when diary text is entered, toggles between 'visible' and 'hidden' states. FlatList grid rendering issue on web is pre-existing - the API returns data correctly but FlatList with numColumns=2 doesn't render items on React Native Web.
